notes.title: Builders of Greece Now in Full Release!🏛️⚒️

Builders of Greece is now in Full Release with a Major Update🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/


What's New?


 Building over time
 New scenario
 New map
 Decree system
 Economy panel
 Trade system
 Quick view of the most important building information
 Other gods - Demeter, Hephaestus, Hades, Ares
 New buildings
 More building animations
 Lots of balance changes, fixes, QoL and general improvement of the game quality

Thank You, Builder!

notes.title: Age of War milestone - Update #3
notes.notes:
Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️
[hr][/hr]
It's been a while, but we're back with another update. And this is the big one! Before we discuss all the novelties we prepared for you, let us thank you for your awesome feedback, rulers. Your opinions have been instrumental in helping us craft a series of improvements to enhance your adventure. Rest assured, we’re always keeping an eye on your ideas and comments, and we deeply value your continued support in shaping the future of the game.


And now - Update #3!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/593e662bef81c1e0667470bda9d13f51072a5292.png


Age of War Milestone - Update #3 📜
[hr][/hr]
Major changes:
• Added a new Sacrifices feature to enhance players' relationships with the gods
• Added information about the risk of sickness occurring
• Added new tooltip showcasing the house dwellers' happiness
• Added information about the produced and consumed goods balance in the production buildings
• Added a new consumption system that makes citizens use the given resource globally, instead of dividing its consumption to every single house
• Wide-ranging rebalance of the economy (resources extraction, production and services)
• Fixed a bug where Stables produced wood
• Fixed bugs related to saving and loading the game
• Improvements to the military units recruitment (faster recruitment time when more military buildings are available)
• Military units now travel faster
• From now on, only the available resources are visible in warehouses and on the panel at the top of the screen


Minor changes:
• Added sound for destroying a building
• Added a new information icon when warehouses are full
• Added a new information icon when production buildings are out of needed resources
• Fixed an issue that caused warehouse workers to get stuck
• Fixed an issue where upgrading a building canceled its sickness status
• Fixed an issue with placing farms near farming buildings
• UI improvements to the Tactical Combat panel and a number of other UI improvements
• A number of other minor bug fixes and quality of life improvements
• Numerous optimization and visual fixes

notes.title: Builders of Greece full release is coming on May 6, 2025
notes.notes:
Huge news, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️
[hr][/hr]
Rejoice, emperors! Our journey through the Early Access phase is nearing its end, and soon we will all get to experience the full version of the Builders of Greece project. While our road to this point has been bumpy and winding at times, thanks to your steadfast commitment, continued support, and invaluable feedback, we can now see the goal... and it's very near.


Builders of Greece full release is coming on May 6, 2025
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a0587f11d174dc6ee6872e0c766b2423895e71e3.png

That's right, in just about 2 months you will be able to discover all the mechanics, features, scenarios, functionalities and surprises that we have prepared for you. Mark this special date on your calendars, builders, as May 6, 2025 you will sit on the ancient throne in all your glory. 

Know, that our team does everything in its power to provide you with the best possible experience and irons out the last imperfections as we speak. We are aware that Builders of Greece is not yet completely problem-free, however, we are looking to the future with our heads held high, and we are steadfast in our efforts to ensure that everything goes smooth and according to plan. 

You can expect a lot of new interesting information on the full release soon, so as always - stay tuned!


Builders of Greece Age of War - Update #3 🛠️
[hr][/hr]
The announcement of the release date does not of course mean that we will stop updating current game content. On the occasion of today's announcement, we would also like to present you the latest changes that have just appeared in our title!


Age of War - Update #3 changelog:
• Added new translations of bonuses awarded by the gods 
• Fixed issues related to loading saved games
• Fixed issues with delivering goods by warehouse workers
• Fixed a bug that allowed to change units movement during their animation
• Fixed a bug that caused destroying a bandit camp to not complete the mission
• Fixed a bug that caused the deletion of a road leading to a warehouse to not display a “no road connection” icon
• Fixed bugs related to lags and stutters, and buildings / resources issues after loading the saved game
• Fixed a bug that caused incorrect display of Chinese letters
• Fixed a number of bugs related to the gods system
• Fixed a bug that caused the Healer's House to not work properly and sick households to increase their happiness
• Fixed a bug that allowed to endlessly replenish one army squad
• Fixed a bug that caused the destruction of a field in an agricultural building not to affect its productivity and production time.
• Adjustments to the buildings' operation areas



Join the community 💭

As always, we are very happy to hear your feedback and get to know your expectations even better, so visit our social media channels and Discord server to share your thoughts. Thank you, Builders!

notes.title: Early Access - Patch 0.10.0 🛠️
notes.notes:
Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️
[hr][/hr]
Not so long ago, we celebrated the release of the "Great People" milestone presented on our Content RoadMap, but our work continues at full speed. Thanks to your valuable feedback, which you willingly share via Steam, social media channels and our Discord server, we have managed to prepare another significant Patch.

Brace yourselves, Rulers! Changes are coming...
[hr][/hr]
As usual, you can check out all the new features summarized in our Patch Notes. However, we also invite you to the more descriptive part, which can be found below the novelties list 📜 There, we provide more information about the changes introduced in the new update and explain in more detail how they will affect your empire and the people inhabiting it. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a7852732726eec08b34106258aa3faadcf36246d.png


Patch 0.10.0 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
• Added distinguished food preferences among different social classes and raised the amount of food that all classes eat

• Enhanced pathfinding algorithm for Storage Workers. Storage Workers now pick paths that are shorter and try to pick new ones after building new or destroying existing roads

• The player can now view the path of the Storage Workers more precisely after clicking them

• The importance of Agora and Marketplace has been increased. Houses outside their range (marked with an appropriate icon) cannot refill their local Pantry to its full value, which lowers the overall happiness level of specific social classes

• Performing basic rituals in religious buildings is now easier due to lowering amount and variety of resources needed

• Added new gods-devoted decorations, the construction of which slows down the decline in their Cult Points

• Better balance of prices of the goods when trading. Now every resource is properly valued, and the selling price is lower than buying one

• Changes to the random events - from now on they offer more detailed information, and their effects on gameplay have been rebalanced

• Merchants now inform the player about the goods they offer in advance, even when Polis don't have access to given good

• Wax and Wax Boards will be now more early-game resources

• Relocation of production buildings is now always available

• The number of current employees of the given production building (after its work was suspended) is now displayed correctly

• Enhanced transparency of the Workforce Panel in Economy Panel. Now adjusting priority and boosting specific buildings should be more clear

PLEASE NOTE 👇
Keep a close eye on your city's food supplies after updating the game. The new Patch may cause them to start melting quickly as residents are now consuming more food!



And now - additional explanations 🤓
[hr][/hr]
As promised at the beginning of this entry, we’ve also prepared some more in-depth details about the new changes. They will give you an even better understanding of what will happen in your city thanks to the Patch 0.10.0, so... here they are!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/3077e82705b53cd7471b2562382a428d9fc4c4f1.gif

The diet of your subjects 🐟
We noticed that overflowing granaries in your Polis were a common sight, and therefore decided to increase the gluttony of each social group, which now prefers a particular type of food. The Thets are most likely to devour fish, representatives of the Zeugitai class relish red meat, and the Geomori may not refuse fish and meat, but it is wheat products that they like best.

Storage Workers 📦
Storage Workers tirelessly move goods around your city, often so focused on their tasks that they miss the designated paths you've set for them. That’s no longer the case. Now, all Storage Workers will follow optimized routes to Warehouses and Production Buildings, responding to every new road created. 

Capricious Pantheon ⚡
The Greek Gods can be capricious at times, but we understand that their anger was not something that should fall so often on your thriving Polis. To remedy this, we sent a delegation all the way to the top of Olympus and convinced each of the Gods to hold back their anger long enough for the city to spread its wings. Performing basic rituals in their name is now easier due to the lowering amount and variety of resources needed. Not to mention new sacred decorations that will slow down the decline in their satisfaction.

New trading prices ⚖️
We have sent our chief economist on a mission to revalidate the prices of goods and resources in other cities, and now you can be sure that each of them is worth the right number of drachmas. It’s up to you to choose if your wealth will come from precious metals, large-scale raw material production, or by mastering a niche sector and trading the most advanced goods.



Join our Community and talk to our team about your awesome ideas
[hr][/hr]
As always, we remain at your disposal on our Social Media, Discord server and Steam Discussions channels! 📢

notes.title: The latest Patch - Blessing of Olympus - is now LIVE ⚡
notes.notes:
Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️
[hr][/hr]
If you've seen our new Early Access Content RoadMap, you probably know that today, Builders of Greece will welcome some very special guests. Some of them are kind and caring, others do not shy away from violence... and all of them, without exception, are extremely powerful!

Without them, the culture and development of Ancient Greece would not have been the same. And it's not just about wonderful temples, altars, or the godsfearing everyday life of all social classes 🙏 Shared beliefs helped cement communities, making it easier for them to work together and pursue common goals. You and your subjects must also stand before the Gods to gain their favor... or ignite their wrath. And so - let's welcome them to your Polis!


It's time to meet your Patrons 🤓
[hr][/hr]
All of the Gods will gladly accept your prayers and appreciation. However, to effectively demonstrate your devotion, you must first prepare an appropriate place. Religious buildings are perfect for this purpose, the first of which is the Altar. Once the Altar or other building of this kind finds its place in your city, you will gain access to the new panel shown below 👇

(Click to expand)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/6cb4872876c6c94fd2d777dc354612c8900e966c.png

In the Faith panel, you can see the satisfaction of individual Gods and learn how they can help you with their favors. Each of the religious buildings can be dedicated to one of the Patrons, and it is up to you to forge your own mortals-to-Gods strategy! 

Will your Polis become a place of worship, or will you satisfy them with the bare minimum? Will you commit to one particular God, or will you try to be on good terms with them all? 🤔 The decision is yours alone, and each choice will have its consequences... To make your task easier, we have prepared a short cheat sheet!

Each God excels in a specific area
[hr][/hr]
🏹 Artemis - Goddess of hunt, wild nature, moon and animals - thanks to her support, your ranged units will be more efficient in battle, and your Hunter's Hut will produce more meat

💕 Aphrodite - Goddess of love, beauty and desire - with her help, your population will grow and reproduce faster, providing you with a stable influx of new subjects

🍇 Dionysus - God of wine, theater and ecstasy - through his passion for celebration, he will help you prepare important rituals that other Gods will surely appreciate

🔥 Hephaestus - God of fire and craftsmanship - thanks to his divine endurance and strength, Hephaestus improves the combat potential of your infantry units

😇 Hestia - Goddess of family, travelers and newborns - her kindness and caring nature strengthens the bonds between the inhabitants of your city and allows more of them to fit under the roof of one house


Rituals and the fury of the Gods ⚡
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7bd7add01b9b4ac5f97c72297e246911368639b3.gif

The most effective way to win a God's favor is by performing special rituals in a dedicated place of worship. Preparing such rituals is often time-consuming and can be expensive, as the appropriate goods are needed to carry them out. Nevertheless, as you already know, it is a profitable investment. Especially since ignoring the jealous Ancient Gods is not a good idea...

The Gods can show their displeasure in various ways - and none of them are good for your city! 😱 Angry Patrons may, for example:

• scare animals away from your hunting grounds
• cause a plague of infertility
• spark off the degradation of tools and valuable items
• turn other divine beings against your Polis
• cause random houses to fall into ruin... 

And unfortunately, there may be more such negative effects! ☠️ With that in mind, be sure to carefully plan your relationships with the inhabitants of Olympus.


Improvements to the Technology system 📜
[hr][/hr]
While the introduction of the Faith system is the biggest change in today's Patch, it is not the only one. Based on your feedback, we also decided to make a number of changes to another very important feature of the game, namely the Technology system. 

An overhaul of the Technology system is aimed at increasing its influence on the game throughout its course 🧐 This means that your development decisions will now have an even greater impact on how your entire Polis performs. Moreover, from now on you have the possibility to choose the development path that best suits you, which was not so strongly emphasized before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/f5d2cb0443434c2b834469309a84a6eb32960793.gif

More specifically, the Technology system has been divided into two kinds of perks: basic and elite ⭐ The first of them is necessary to push your city forward, while the latter will show their full potential in the mid and late game. Thanks to precisely adjusted gradation, elite perks will affect areas such as various production modifiers or the improvement of combat units.


New Maps 🗺️
[hr][/hr]
Many of you, eager for new challenges, asked about new maps. We have done our best to fulfill this request, and so... we're happy to announce that with today's update, two new unexplored lands have appeared in Sandbox mode! And this is by no means the end - we will soon present you with even more maps, both in Scenario and Sandbox modes. Explorers, rejoice! 😁

• Olympus Island - land of plateaus and plains, with a few gentle descents to the blue sea. A perfect place to build a vast, powerful Polis stretching to the horizon. If you dream of a city built at different heights, this place is just perfect.

• Hera Island - this unique island boasts a long, straight shoreline that can be used for maritime trade and fishing. Inland stretches a vast plain, the edges of which are marked by high, inaccessible yet majestic mountains.

Thank you for your time, Builders! We wish you many new awesome adventures in the mystical world of Ancient Greece. May the Gods bless you all! 🙏

We cannot stress enough how much we appreciate your understanding, enthusiasm and continued support, everyone! 


* PLEASE NOTE: Despite our best efforts, those with slightly older PCs may still experience loading issues. Please make sure your PC meets the game's minimum requirements. With saving issues behind us, let's talk about the future
[hr][/hr]
While we were getting rid of loading problems, you shared tons of interesting suggestions, ideas and feedback. Please know that your input was very inspiring for us and that many of your ideas ended up on our to-do list 😁📜 Each of your entries on Steam Discussions, our Discord Server and Social Media channels is thoroughly analyzed and discussed, so keep them coming! Thanks to you, we have drawn many important conclusions and gained many valuable insights for the future. Teamwork OP! 💪


Patches with the brand-new content... and a Content RoadMap

From now on we can focus on what we like the most, namely providing you with new content, features, systems and opportunities to improve your ancient cities. To tell the truth, our team is already enthusiastically engaged in crafting the next Patch, which will bring a bunch of cool novelties... and it's gonna be big! 

Speaking of plans for the future, we have one more awesome news for you 📢 It's likely that we'll soon release a Content RoadMap, providing you with precise details about the stages and updates we have in store. notes.notes:
Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️
[hr][/hr]
As you know, over the last few weeks, our attention has been directed towards identifying and resolving critical bugs you reported to our team. And although it was quite a challenge, we think it's safe to say now, that we've successfully addressed the most pressing issue: crashes upon loading the game 💾 

(NOTE: Players running the game on devices with lower specifications than the minimum hardware requirements are advised that they may experience errors and crashes; in such cases, please send us your crash report at support@blumentmt.com - you can find them at C:/Users/[user]/AppData/Local/Temp/BLUM Entertainment/Builders of Greece/Crashes)


But the good news does not end here, as there are several other important points worth mentioning 👇 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/3460055165aab8c779d1b02ab0246771fd318602.png

• We're aware that placing long roads can cause freezes or even crashes. Our team is committed to optimizing and solving this issue as quickly as possible.

• Please note that the game is not yet optimized to work with integrated GPUs, meaning some of them might work, some might not. We're still working on optimizing the game and making it available to as broad variety of PCs as possible. As it stands now, 6GB of dedicated VRAM is a minimum our QA concluded to be played on.

As always - thank you for your awesome feedback and detailed descriptions of the issues you encountered 🤓 Keep them coming, all right?

- Improvement of logistics and AI of citizens - we know that you have encountered situations where groups of workers or even entire workshops simply stopped working. We have taken a closer look at this issue and such situations should no longer occur

- Minor UI and Tutorial adjustments 

- Minor Technology Tree adjustments

- Resolving translation problems

- Resolving the issue with the blocked mouse cursor

- A number of other small fixes and improvements that enhance the gameplay experience


Know that your feedback is extremely important to our entire team! We will really appreciate it if you decide to play the Prologue Playtest again, this time with the fixes and adjustments listed above! Thank you! 😁

notes.title: Builders of Greece Playtest update
notes.notes:
🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ 
[hr][/hr]
Over the last two days, we have received A LOT of feedback, reports, and suggestions... and you know what? We simply love it! 😍 You can be sure that all of them are thoroughly analyzed by our team. It was thanks to the data collected from our testers that we were able to launch the first update of our Playtest! Are you curious what has changed? 

Let's take a look!

The short answer is... quite a lot!  We've decided not to describe every single change in detail, but rather give you an overview of the implemented fixes in the form of a list 📜:

• Camera movement and control improvements
• Illegible fonts fixes
• Localization improvements
• UI scaling fixes
• UI text fixes
• Adjustments to the balance of food and resource production
• Adjustments to the maintenance costs of some buildings
• Numerous AI improvements
• Building removal system improvements
• Fixes to progress saving and loading systems
• Terrain fixes
• Numerous bugs fixes


However, our work doesn't stop there! 🛑 Our next goal is to finish all the UI panels, fully fix localization issues, add new animations and AI interactions, implement support for new resolutions, and further bug fixes. The Demo Version is around the corner, but we believe that thanks to your continued support and awesome feedback, we will get 100% out of it! Thank you, everyone! 😉
